_comment: Ground-truth boxes for camera/zmilk/scanN.jpg, [x0,y0,x1,y1] fractions of the 320x320 square. RE-MEASURED 12 Nov 2026, before any new finder was scored against them: the original boxes (kept in experiments/finder-truth-before-2026-11-12/test-9.json) were rough enough that a PERFECTLY placed box could score near or below the 30% overlap that training/lib/finder_eval.js counts as a hit - scan2/6/8 had been copied from the old finder's own output and sat high and left of the chocolate, and scan4 covered only its top half. Every chocolate was re-measured automatically from the photo (the darkest connected blob inside the old box, the same method for every frame in test-9/10/11) and each result checked by eye on a zoomed coordinate grid. Original values: scan1 [0.448,0.573,0.573,0.698], scan2 [0.282,0.364,0.548,0.630], scan3 [0.484,0.484,0.583,0.583], scan4 [0.469,0.422,0.583,0.531], scan5 [0.4375,0.599,0.568,0.729], scan6 [0.3575,0.2465,0.6185,0.5075], scan7 [0.422,0.464,0.578,0.625], scan8 [0.360,0.336,0.618,0.594], scan9 [0.495,0.547,0.604,0.646].
